battle.name: 唐與東突厥的戰爭
battle.brief: 貞觀三年（629）十一月，唐太宗以李靖為定襄道行軍總管，分六道兵馬北伐，李靖率三千精騎自馬邑疾馳，夜襲惡陽嶺，攻破頡利可汗於定襄鐵山牙帳，頡利走保磧口被擒。卡面亞述長弓公元前七世紀不入此役，但它「車兵靠弓兵開路」的分工，正是唐軍以弓弩步卒先遠射、再以步騎合擊的翻版。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 本役的交戰雙方是唐朝與東突厥汗庭。唐太宗在貞觀初年把北方軍務交給兵部尚書李靖，指揮系統是兵部與行軍總管府：貞觀三年九月下詔分六道進兵，定襄道李靖、朔方道李勣、靈州道柴紹，另有張公謹、丘行恭、李道宗各領一軍，府兵與蕃兵編為步、騎兩軍，糧秣由靈州、朔州、馬邑、定襄四處屯倉供給，兵部與度支共同負擔轉輸。東突厥方面，頡利可汗在貞觀元年前後平定了北面的反抗者與西部的薛延陀等部，統一漠北，以牙帳為中樞，左右賢王、俟斤、達干各領一部，號令出自牙帳而部眾各有所屬，控弦之眾號稱百萬，馬匹與部眾由各部自己掌握，汗庭能直接調度的不過數萬。汗庭與唐的關係，是一方面稱臣納貢、一方面連年南下，貞觀初年頡利曾率眾逼近關中，長安戒嚴。因此唐廷的戰略先從分化外圍入手：拉攏鐵勒、靺鞨，令內應於牙帳，同時以李靖所部作最後的斬首之舉。
countriesEn: The two parties in this campaign were the Tang dynasty and the court of the Eastern Turks. In the early Zhenguan years Emperor Taizong put the northern war in the hands of Li Jing, Minister of War, and the command ran through the Ministry of War and the offices of the military governors: in the ninth month of Zhenguan 3 (629) an edict sent the army out in six columns, Li Jing for the Dingxiang circuit, Li Ji for the Shuofang circuit and Chai Shao for the Lingzhou circuit, with Zhang Gongjin, Qiu Xenggong and Li Daozong each leading a force of their own. Palace troops and tribal auxiliaries were organised into foot and horse, and the grain was drawn from the storehouses at Lingzhou, Shuofang, Mayi and Dingxiang, with the Ministry of War and the Ministry of Revenue sharing the burden of transport. On the Turkic side, Jieli Khan had settled the resistance in the north and the tribes of the west such as Xueyantuo around the first year of Zhenguan and unified the northern desert. The yurt was the hub, with left and right wise-kings, the serks and the darqans each commanding a division. Orders came from the yurt, but the divisions owned their own men: the host was said to number a hundred thousand bowmen, yet each division held its own horses and its own people, and the khanate could not directly move more than some tens of thousands. The relation between the khanate and the Tang was a mixture of a court that professed submission and sent tribute and an army that came south year after year; in the early Zhenguan years Jieli brought his people close to the Guanzhong plain and Chang'an was put on the alert. The Tang therefore began with the division of the enemy periphery: drawing the Tiele and the Mohe to their side, planting agents inside the yurt, and keeping Li Jing's force for the final blow at the head of the state.
people: 關鍵人物分四組。第一組是太宗李世民：貞觀三年九月他本欲親征涇陽，長孫無忌、房玄齡、魏徵等力諫乃止，改命李靖出師；戰前他以諸道分兵制衡將門，戰後又親至定襄城下迎接歸順諸部，渭水之會盟亦由他一手安排。第二組是主帥李靖：此人用兵喜出其不意，選精騎三千自馬邑疾馳，十餘日抵惡陽嶺，直趨鐵山，諸將請止而靖不許，一戰破頡利牙帳。第三組是諸道將領，李勣以朔方道行軍總管的身份截斷頡利北走的退路，是唐初最能與李靖配合的老將；柴紹、張公謹、丘行恭、李道宗各道一軍，其中李道宗部將張寶相追至磧口，生擒頡利可汗；蘇定方是李靖的前鋒，鐵山夜襲時率騎直薄牙帳。第四組是突厥一方：頡利可汗年輕時曾以十萬騎助隋滅高句麗，統一漠北之後卻在分化與奇襲之下失去全部主動。
peopleEn: The key figures fall into four groups. The first is Emperor Taizong, Li Shimin: in the ninth month of Zhenguan 3 he intended to ride to Jingyang himself, but Zhangsun Wuji, Fang Xuanling, Wei Zheng and the rest argued him out of it, and he sent Li Jing instead. Before the campaign he divided the forces among the circuits so that no single general should dominate, and afterwards he went himself to the foot of Dingxiang to receive the divisions that came in; the covenant at the Wei was his own arrangement. The second is the commander, Li Jing: a man who liked to appear where he was not expected, who chose three thousand picked horse and rode out of Mayi, reached Ayang Ridge in something over ten days and pushed straight for Tieshan, and who would not stop though his officers asked him to, breaking the yurt of Jieli in a single stroke. The third are the commanders of the other circuits. Li Ji, as military governor of Shuofang, cut the road by which Jieli might flee north, and was the old general best able to work with Li Jing; Chai Shao, Zhang Gongjin, Qiu Xenggong and Li Daozong each led a column, and among Li Daozong's men Zhang Baoxiang pursued to Qikou and took Jieli alive. Su Dingfang was Li Jing's vanguard and led the horse straight against the yurt in the night attack on Tieshan. The fourth is the Turkic side itself: Jieli Khan, who as a young man had ridden with ten thousand horsemen to help the Sui destroy Goguryeo, and who after uniting the northern desert lost every initiative under the combination of division and night attack.
kits: 卡面那件亞述長弓是公元前八至前七世紀兩河流域的產物：短身、弓力強、木胎而以角筋為輔，箭鏃有鐵、骨兩種，是亞述軍隊中最普及的武器。亞述人把它編進車陣當作開路的力量：車前有持盾步行兵與長矛手，車上射手在車行進之中放箭，箭雨先壓住對方陣線，車兵再乘勢撞入，這正是「弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路」。同一套分工也出現在貞觀三年的漠北。唐軍的射手是步弩兵與角弓射手，步弩與排弩列於前排覆蓋射界，角弓射手在兩翼與騎兵之間放箭；貞觀初年唐軍步兵仍以弓弩為主、槊刀為輔，尚未進到以大盾結陣的階段，遠射先手的份量比隋末更重。車的方面唐有障車：木製車體蒙牛皮，車前裝長槊以拒騎兵，車上置弩供射手使用，思路與亞述輕車相通而工藝、防護不同。突厥騎兵不披重甲，披皮袍與小片革甲，用角弓、骨鏃與短槊，帳幕為氈，鼓角齊整，靠駱駝馱載帳篷與乳酪。
kitsEn: The kit on this card, the Assyrian bow, is a product of Mesopotamia of the eighth and seventh centuries BCE: short, powerful, wooden with horn and sinew reinforcement, with arrowheads of iron or bone, and the most common weapon in the Assyrian army. The Assyrians wove it into their chariot order as the force that opened the way. Shield-bearers and pikemen walked ahead of the horses, the shooter on the platform loosed arrows while the chariot was still moving, the shower of arrows pinned the enemy line, and the chariot then drove into the gap: exactly the arrangement described in the kit note, that the archer shoots from the chariot and the chariot relies on the archer to open the way. The same division of labour appears on the northern desert in Zhenguan 3. The Tang shooters were crossbow infantry and bow archers, with single and splayed crossbows in the front ranks covering the field of fire and bow archers loosing from between the flanks and the horse. In the early Tang the foot still fought bow and crossbow first with spear and sabre in support, and had not yet reached the stage of closing up behind large shields, so the weight of the long-range first strike was heavier than it had been at the end of the Sui. On the subject of vehicles the Tang had the armoured barricade cart: a wooden body covered in oxhide, long spears fixed at the front to turn horse, and a crossbow carried on the platform for the shooter. The idea is common to the Assyrian light chariot, but the workmanship and the protection are not. The Turkic horse carried no heavy armour but sheepskin coats and small pieces of leather, and used composite bows, bone arrowheads and short spears; their tents were of felt, drums and horns were kept in order, and camels carried the tent-poles and the dairy.
tactics: 唐軍的戰術是三段式。第一段奇襲斬首：貞觀三年十一月，李靖率三千精騎自馬邑出其不意，晝伏夜行，十餘日抵惡陽嶺，遇雨不止，直趨鐵山；距頡利牙帳七百里時諸將請止，靖以為機不可失，遂行，及至頡利尚寢，靖令蘇定方掩擊，焚其牙帳，頡利驚走。第二段諸道合擊與追擊：柴紹自靈州、李勣自朔州、丘行恭等各道同時壓上，截其歸路，李道宗率騎追至磧口，張寶相擒頡利。第三段政治攻心：牙帳既失其首，諸部尚屯於定襄一帶，太宗率諸軍至渭水，與突厥諸帥隔水而語，設酒相會，以渭水為界，諸部乃引眾而歸。弓箭的用法也講究分工：步弩與排弩在前排遠射，角弓射手在騎兵兩側策應，騎兵靠馬力追擊與繞擊，正是亞述車陣「弓兵開路、車兵收功」的放大版。
tacticsEn: The Tang method ran in three movements. First, the surprise stroke at the head: in the eleventh month of Zhenguan 3, Li Jing took three thousand picked horse out of Mayi unexpectedly, lay up by day and marched by night, reached Ayang Ridge in something over ten days, pushed on through the rain, and came to Tieshan; when his officers asked him to stop at the point seven hundred li from Jieli's yurt he judged the chance too good to lose and went on, and by the time he arrived Jieli was still asleep, so Li Jing sent Su Dingfang to fall upon the camp and burn the yurt, and Jieli fled. Second, the convergence of the columns and the pursuit: Chai Shao came from Lingzhou, Li Ji from Shuofang, Qiu Xenggong and the rest pressed in at the same time to bar the road of escape, and Li Daozong rode in pursuit to Qikou, where Zhang Baoxiang took Jieli. Third, the political offensive: with the head of the khanate gone, the divisions were still posted around Dingxiang, and Taizong came down to the Wei with his armies, spoke with the Turkic commanders across the water, and a feast was set, the Wei being taken as the line; the divisions then turned and led their people home. The use of the bow had its own division of labour as well: single and splayed crossbows gave the long-range fire from the front ranks, bow archers supported the horse on the flanks, and the horse did the pursuit and the turning stroke. It is the Assyrian chariot order, that the archer opens the way and the chariot takes the credit, enlarged.
data: 兵力數字要打折看。《資治通鑑》記李靖所部精騎三千，李勣一路步騎十萬，諸道合兵則有「三十餘萬」一類的概數，其中顯然包含大量蕃兵與運糧丁夫。鐵山一戰，史料記斬首萬餘級、俘虜男女十餘萬、雜畜數十萬頭，這類數字把被擄走的部眾與牲畜一併算入，無法核對。行程方面，馬邑至惡陽嶺數百里，全軍行十餘日至鐵山，自鐵山至頡利牙帳尚有七百里，後段追奔至磧口又是數百里；突擊階段日行二百餘里，夜間銜枚疾進不設營。糧秣是硬限制：唐軍以靈州、朔州、馬邑、定襄為屯糧之所，騎兵作戰一日耗馬料數倍，離開這四處據點便難以維持，故追擊雖銳而不能深入漠北。會盟時，突厥諸部尚屯兵於定襄一線，騎兵數以萬計，太宗親至渭水時隨行甲士數千，營壘沿渭水一線列開，以此壓住會盟的場合。
dataEn: Figures of troops have to be taken with a discount. The Comprehensive Mirror records three thousand picked horse under Li Jing, a hundred thousand foot and horse in Li Ji's column, and for the columns together a round figure of some three hundred thousand, which plainly includes a great many auxiliaries and the men transporting grain. For the battle at Tieshan the sources give more than ten thousand heads cut off, more than a hundred thousand men and women taken, and some hundreds of thousands of head of mixed livestock, numbers that fold in the people carried off and the animals and cannot be checked. On distance: from Mayi to Ayang Ridge is some hundreds of li, the column took something over ten days to reach Tieshan, another seven hundred li lay between Tieshan and Jieli's yurt, and the pursuit on to Qikou was several hundred li more. During the stroke the column covered more than two hundred li a day and marched at night with the horses tied and the men silent, without pitching camp. Supply was the hard limit. The Tang drew its grain from Lingzhou, Shuofang, Mayi and Dingxiang, and a horse at work consumed several times its keep in a day, so once the army left those four points the force could no longer be fed, and that is why the pursuit was sharp but did not go deep into the northern desert. At the time of the covenant the Turkic divisions were still posted on the Dingxiang line, with some tens of thousands of horse, and when Taizong came to the Wei he had a few thousand armoured men with him, the camp drawn up along the river to give weight to the occasion.
cause: 打起來有遠因也有近因。近因是頡利可汗在貞觀初年統一漠北之後連年南下：他的部眾號稱百萬，馬匹充足，弓箭精準，唐廷深以為患，關中多次戒嚴，太宗曾有親征之議，長安上下以為非增兵不足以抵禦。遠因是唐朝自身的邊防取向：隋末以來北邊諸部多附於突厥，唐若要讓漠北恢復漢家的羈縻格局，就必須先打掉這個核心；同時頡利汗庭之內並不齊整，突利可汗一部早已內附唐朝，唐在突厥內部有嚮導、有情報，也有鐵勒、靺鞨願意倒戈的渠道。促成開戰的還有雙方的時間表：突厥連年用兵，部眾疲於奔命，馬力下降；唐軍經兩三年整備已練出精騎，一旦探知牙帳的位置與路徑，就決定以一次奇襲取代正面會戰。
causeEn: There was a distant cause and an immediate one. The immediate cause was that Jieli Khan came south year after year after uniting the northern desert in the early Zhenguan years: his host was said to number a hundred thousand, his horses were plentiful and his archers were accurate, and the court at Chang'an took the danger seriously, the capital being placed on the alert more than once, and Taizong at one point spoke of riding out in person, his ministers judging that without more troops the frontier could not be held. The distant cause was the orientation of Tang frontier policy itself. Since the end of the Sui the northern peoples had mostly attached themselves to the Turks, and if the Tang were to restore the old Han pattern of command over the northern desert, it had to break that core first. At the same time Jieli's court was not whole: the division of Tuli Khan had already come over to the Tang, so the Tang had guides and intelligence inside the khanate, and had channels through which the Tiele and the Mohe would turn. There was also a timetable on both sides. The Turks had been campaigning continuously, the divisions were worn out by constant movement and the horses were failing, while the Tang had spent two or three years preparing and could now field picked horse; once the position of the yurt and the road to it were known, it was decided to replace a set-piece battle with one surprise stroke.
impact: 這一戰改變了北亞的權力格局。頡利可汗被擒、牙帳覆沒之後，東突厥的汗庭權威就此崩解，數十萬部眾北走或散歸各部，唐朝在漠南以定襄、雲中等都督府和羈縻州縣收編內附諸部，並在極北以「以夷制夷」的方式冊立鐵勒、回紇等部的首領、開放邊市，讓漠北各部互相牽制，而不必年年出塞。制度上的好處是唐朝從此不再倚賴長城，邊防支點由牆垣轉為都督府與羈縻羣；壞處是留給後世的是一份更長的帳單：漠北秩序並未一勞永逸，鐵勒、回紇先後強大，車師、薛延陀反覆，直到貞觀二十年（646）滅薛延陀、勒石燕然，漠北才真正安定。對唐廷本身，這是貞觀年間最見效的一次邊功，太宗由此確立了對北方「冊封羈縻、邊市換馬」的思路，後來平高昌、滅高句麗、征薛延陀都沿用同一套節奏；而被拆散的突厥部眾各自尋找出路，日後以車師、薛延陀、迴鶻的名義再度北上。
impactEn: This campaign changed the balance of power in northern Asia. With Jieli taken and the yurt destroyed, the authority of the Eastern Turkic court collapsed at once, and several hundred thousand people moved north or scattered back to their divisions. In the south of the desert the Tang gathered the surrendered peoples into commanderies and dependent prefectures and counties at Dingxiang, Yunzhong and elsewhere, and in the far north ruled the Tiele, the Huihe and other chiefs by grant and recognition and opened the border markets, so that the tribes of the northern desert held one another in check and the court no longer had to ride out every year. The institutional gain was that the Tang no longer leaned on a wall: the pivot of the frontier shifted from ramparts to commanderies and dependent tribes. The cost was a longer bill handed down to later ages. The order of the northern desert did not settle for good; the Tiele and the Huihe grew strong in turn, and Chushi and Xueyantuo kept coming back, until the defeat of Xueyantuo in Zhenguan 20 (646) and the stone carved at Yanran left the northern desert genuinely quiet. For the court at Chang'an this was the most effective piece of frontier work of the Zhenguan years, and it fixed the Tang pattern for the north, granting titles and holding dependent peoples, trading horses at the border market; the reduction of Gaochang, the war against Goguryeo and the campaign against Xueyantuo were all run to the same rhythm. For the tribes of the steppe, the breaking up of the Eastern Turks left each division to find its own road, and some of them came north again in later years under the names of Chushi, Xueyantuo and Huihe.
result: 結果是唐軍完勝。鐵山一戰破頡利牙帳之後，頡利可汗北走磧口，為部將張寶相所擒，貞觀四年（630）正月被押送長安；太宗赦其死罪，授以郡公爵位，宴之於順天宮，又令其觀洛陽府庫之積，俾知中國之富。諸部則於渭水之會盟，約以渭水為界，引眾北歸，東突厥從此名存實亡。戰術層面，此役確立了唐初對草原的標準打法：精騎奇襲破首、諸道合擊收尾、會盟收編諸部，用兵不血刃而瓦解一個汗國。兵制層面則留下兩個問題：一是府兵制的騎兵本錢有限，湊出數千精騎需要長時間的整備，一旦錯失奇襲的時機便難再勝；二是被打散的突厥部眾成了新的邊患，貞觀末年仍有侵擾，直到貞觀二十年以後才基本清理完。
resultEn: The result was a complete Tang victory. After the yurt was broken at Tieshan, Jieli Khan fled north to Qikou and was taken alive by his own officer Zhang Baoxiang, and was brought to Chang'an in the first month of Zhenguan 4 (630). Taizong pardoned his death sentence, gave him a command and a title as a commandery prince, feasted him at the Shuntian Palace, and had him shown the stores of Luoyang so that he would know how rich the Middle Kingdom was. The divisions, for their part, met in the covenant at the Wei, agreed the Wei as the line, and led their people north, so that the Eastern Turks survived in name only. At the level of method, the campaign set the standard Tang answer to the steppe: picked horse striking the head by surprise, the columns converging to finish the business, and a covenant to gather in the divisions, an entire khanate undone without a pitched battle. At the level of institutions it left two problems. The fubing system had a limited stock of horse, and to assemble several thousand picked riders took years of preparation; once the moment for surprise was missed the victory could not simply be repeated. And the Turkic peoples scattered by the campaign became a new source of trouble on the frontier, still raiding in the late Zhenguan years and only finally cleared up after Zhenguan 20.
